chunks: My father, may Allah be pleased with him, said in his letter to me:

Know, my son, that the origin of giving the choice is that Allah, Blessed and Exalted, was displeased for His Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, because of a statement said by some of his wives: 'Does Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family, think that if he divorces us, we will not find our equals from Quraysh to marry us?' So Allah commanded His Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, to withdraw from his wives for twenty-nine nights, and the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, withdrew from them in the upper chamber of Umm Ibrahim. Then this verse was revealed:

O Prophet, say to your wives: If you desire the life of this world and its adornment, then come, I will provide for you and release you in a gracious manner. But if you desire Allah and His Messenger and the Hereafter, then indeed Allah has prepared for the good-doers among you a great reward.
So they chose Allah and His Messenger, and divorce did not take place. Had they chosen themselves, they would have been separated.

key_terms.أَكْفَاءَنَا: our suitable equals, meaning socially suitable marriage partners
key_terms.أُسَرِّحْكُنَّ: I will release you, meaning let you go in separation
key_terms.التَّخْيِيرِ: giving the choice, here referring to offering a wife the option connected to separation
key_terms.سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا: a gracious release, meaning a dignified parting
key_terms.يَعْتَزِلَ: to withdraw or separate himself temporarily

ai.seo_question: What is the origin of giving a wife the choice in divorce according to this hadith and Quranic verse?
ai.summary: This report explains the background of the verse in which the wives of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم were given a choice between worldly life and Allah, His Messenger, and the Hereafter. It is used here to clarify the legal and textual origin of takhyir, showing that no divorce occurred because they chose Allah and His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: My father (may Allah (swt) be pleased with him) said in his letter to me:

"Know, my son, that the origin of the matter of giving the choice (to divorce) is that Allah (swt), the Blessed and Exalted, was displeased with a statement made by some of the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) wives.
They said: 'Does Muhammad (sw) think that if he divorces us, we will not find suitable husbands from Quraysh to marry us?'
So, Allah (swt) commanded His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) to separate himself from his wives for twenty-nine nights.
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) secluded himself in the chamber of Umm Ibrahim.
Then this verse was revealed:

'O Prophet! Say to your wives: If you desire the life of this world and its adornment, then come, I will provide for you and release you in a gracious manner. But if you desire Allah (swt), His Messenger, and the Hereafter, then indeed Allah (swt) has prepared for the good-doers among you a great reward' (Surah Al-Ahzab 33:28-29).
They chose Allah (swt) and His Messenger (sw), so divorce did not occur. But if they had chosen themselves, they would have been separated."
